en.description:
Wristed packs 86 games into your Apple Watch. From arcade action to brain teasers, built for small screens and small hands.

DESIGNED FOR THE WATCH
Every game fits even the smallest Apple Watch. Turn the Digital Crown to steer, aim, reel and spin in 32 games. Feel your way to the answer with haptics in Safe Cracker and Haptic Hunt.

EASY, MEDIUM OR HARD
Pick your level. Easy is truly easy for young players; Hard will challenge grown-ups.

15 CATEGORIES
Arcade Classics - Snake, Paddle Ball, Brick Break, Stack Tower
Action and Reflex - Tap Champ, Reaction Time, Whack Attack
Brain and Puzzle - Memory Match, Pattern Recall, Four in a Row
Learning - Math Quiz, Spell It, Flag Match
Motion - Jump Counter, Freeze Dance, Spy Mission
Digital Crown - Spin Racer, Fishing Line, Safe Cracker
Creative - Finger Paint, Music Pad, Funny Face
Adventure - Mini Dungeon, Story Snap, Treasure Dig
Luck and Chance - Dice Roller, Dare Spinner, Fortune Cookie
Calm and Bedtime - Zen Pop, Breathing Balloon, Glow
Sports - Mini Hoops, Target Toss, Tap Soccer
Feelings and Friends - Mood Match, Kind Choice
Collection - Creature Catcher, Feed Monster
Challenges - One Minute, Volcano Builder, Haptic Hunt
Utilities - Buzz Board, Flashlight

FEATURES
Quest Mode: create a hero and level up across 71 games
Surprise Me, Favorites and Recently Played
No phone required: plays directly on Apple Watch
Works offline: play on planes, trails, anywhere

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://wristedgames.com/privacy
en.releaseNotes:
Big update — thanks for your feedback!
• Every game now fits your Apple Watch screen, even the smallest ones
• Digital Crown controls in 32 games — steer, aim, reel and spin
• Easy, Medium and Hard: beat the CPU at Tic Tac Toe, Paddle Ball and more
• Fixed the paddle games: the ball no longer slips through or sticks to walls
• New games: Safe Cracker, Four in a Row, Stack Tower and the calm Glow light
• Surprise Me, Favorites and Recently Played
• Looks great on iPhone, iPad and iPhone Duo
• Lots of fixes to make every game fair and fun
en.subtitle: 80+ Arcade, Puzzle & Brain Fun
